title: Vibrant Croatian Cheese Lasagna
description: A malty, cheese-pull Croatian dish featuring khus khus, with a macrobiotic-friendly twist, this lasagna is sure to impress, showcasing a beautiful fold and vibrant colors. It is a perfect show-off dish for any occasion.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions.
In a bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, malty cheese, and parmesan cheese.
Add the toasted khus khus, salt, and black pepper to the cheese mixture and stir well.
In a baking dish, create a thin layer of olive oil.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the olive oil.
Spread half of the cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the cheese mixture, and finally another 4 noodles on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
